title: Mark registration date and professional abbreviation
goal: uses time and abbr to provide a machine-readable date and the full name of the term.
summary: Readers see abbreviated dates, but browsers and tools can recognize full dates through datetime. The full name of CAD serves as a supplement to the abbreviation.
tasks: wraps "May 18" with time, and fills in datetime with 2027-05-18.
uses abbr to wrap "CAD", and the title is "computer-aided design".

example.note: The display text of time can be oriented to readers, and datetime uses standard format. The content of abbr is an abbreviation, and title can provide the full name.

hint: Keep the original sentence and only include the date and abbreviation.
